notes.claim: An electrical one-line diagram outlines connections from power sources through a distribution system to the loads that use the power.
A one-line diagram typically starts at the top with the incoming power and its disconnecting device, and works down.
On a one-line diagram, one line shown for a bus or cable represents all three phases.

sources.title: us coast guard marine safety center plan review guideline
sources.quote: The purpose of an electrical one-line diagram is to provide an elementary schematic outlining connections from power sources (generators, shore power, battery banks) through a distribution system (switchboard, busbars, cables, feeders, and panels) to supply various power consuming loads.

sources.title: How to Read a Single Line Diagram | EECO
sources.quote: A one line typically starts at the top of the page and works its way down. It will start with the utility or other means of incoming power and its disconnecting device.

sources.title: How to Read a Single Line Diagram | EECO
sources.quote: It will have one single line shown for bus (or cable) to represent all three phases.
